summary.ALCOHOL: Alcohol is the clearest trigger of atrial fibrillation episodes: anything containing alcohol is red.
summary.CAFFEINE: High doses of caffeine speed up the heart rate: above the threshold is yellow.
summary.SUGARS: Based on total sugars (no data on added sugars yet); does not apply to fruit and milk.
summary.NA_K_RATIO: Potassium equal to or higher than sodium helps stabilize heart rhythm; a salty food with many times more sodium than potassium is red.
summary.SODIUM: Too much salt causes fluid retention and puts more strain on the heart.
summary.SATURATED_FAT: A lot of saturated fat raises cardiovascular risk.
summary.MAGNESIUM: Rich in magnesium yet low in salt (nuts, beans, whole grains) is a plus for the heart.
summary.VITAMIN_K: On warfarin: no need to avoid it, but keep your vitamin K intake consistent every day.
